# Verification and provenance view

Architecture description alignment profile for ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010:2022; no conformance assessment or certification

Scope: Observed generated distance, proper-warp uncloak, source-owned scalar angular state, angular snapshot/replay and formation wiring. Standalone core completion comes first; Original Blue hosting is deferred. Full world-feature, assurance, platform and production-quality gates remain open. Generated source stop integration now retains uncapped input velocity, with a custom maximum-velocity parameter and source collision preparation before Avian damping setup. The generated aligning-warp dispatch now delegates to the existing source goto thrust while the effect stamp remains negative. Generated spherical partition ownership now extends the existing bubble tracker, with source-defined parent/shared lifetime, master insertion and live GetBallBox queries. Complete/full acceptance remains open.

View `V-verification`; model kind: Evidence and trust-boundary graph. Concerns: Q-evidence, Q-reproduce, Q-behavior.

Compiler extraction establishes the scalar expression structure; syntax comparison checks the existing Rust kernel before reuse. Independent original C++ numeric traces check actual native queries. XML is documentation evidence. Kani observations and Verus scope are separate; generated artifacts, fixture passes and oracle agreement do not grant production refinement or universal equivalence. Angular tests compare 1,224 exact field bits from 136 unchanged original C++ transitions. Direct Rust formation scenarios preserve original fixture setup/order/ten-step coordinates and four-decimal comparison. These are host-scoped observations. Core/full reports share one canonical inventory; unknown or mixed core semantics cannot be deferred because Blue is unavailable. Independent unchanged C++ stop/time-factor/integration samples additionally check all six position/velocity lanes in both source collision configurations. The initial fixtures and an exponential-underflow observation exposed distinct cap and phase-order errors before their fixes. The extended unchanged C++ partition oracle covers 80 client Stop environment/mutation/motion states at four timesteps, and source-backed client-label invariance checks exercise both collision modes.

- `C-partition-generation` → `C-partition`: Emits typed ownership state rules and reuses reviewed source numeric kernels.
